## Problem

What operator, parser, documentation, or maintenance problem does this solve?

## Change

Describe the focused implementation and any tradeoffs.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Parser changes include representative fixtures or tests
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots and keyboard/mobile checks
- [ ] No scene data, credentials, church names, or private network details are included

## Release impact

Describe user-visible behavior, compatibility risk, documentation changes, and rollback notes.
